title: Famous inventors and the country they died in

source.name: Wikidata (CC0)
source.method: sparql:SELECT ?item ?itemLabel ?article ?sitelinks ?countryLabel WHERE { { SELECT ?item (SAMPLE(?c) AS ?country) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?c) AS ?nC) WHERE { ?item wdt:P31 wd:Q5 ; wdt:P106 wd:Q205375 ; wdt:P20 ?bp . ?bp wdt:P17 ?c . ?item wikibase:sitelinks ?s . FILTER(?s >= 30) } GROUP BY ?item } hint:Prior hint:runFirst true . FILTER(?nC = 1) OPTIONAL { ?article schema:about ?item ; schema:isPartOf <https://en.wikipedia.org/> . } ?item wikibase:sitelinks ?sitelinks . rows.label: Steve Jobs
rows.description: American entrepreneur; co-founder of Apple Inc. (1955–2011)
rows.hook: co-founded a computer company and unveiled the iPhone

rows.label: Nikola Tesla
rows.hook: pioneered alternating-current electricity and the induction motor

rows.label: Hedy Lamarr
rows.description: Austrian-American actress and co-inventor of an early technique for spread spectrum communications and frequency hopping (1914-2000)
rows.hook: was a Hollywood film star who co-invented a frequency-hopping radio technique

rows.label: Thomas Edison
rows.hook: is known as the inventor of the practical light bulb and the phonograph

rows.label: Ada Lovelace
rows.hook: wrote what is often called the first computer program, for a mechanical engine

rows.label: Henry Ford
rows.hook: founded a car company and put the world on wheels with the assembly-line Model T

rows.label: Alexander Graham Bell
rows.hook: is credited with patenting the first practical telephone

rows.label: Michael Faraday
rows.hook: discovered electromagnetic induction and gave famous Christmas lectures for children

rows.label: George Washington Carver
rows.hook: promoted peanuts and crop rotation to help struggling farmers

rows.label: Charles Babbage
rows.hook: designed the mechanical Difference Engine and is called the father of the computer

rows.label: Johannes Gutenberg
rows.hook: introduced the movable-type printing press to Europe and printed a famous Bible

rows.label: Guglielmo Marconi
rows.hook: pioneered long-distance radio transmission across the Atlantic

rows.label: Ferdinand Porsche
rows.hook: designed the people's car known as the Beetle

rows.label: Jonas Salk
rows.hook: developed the first widely used polio vaccine and refused to patent it

rows.label: Les Paul
rows.description: American jazz guitarist, country guitarist, songwriter and inventor (1915–2009)
rows.hook: helped create the solid-body electric guitar and pioneered multitrack recording

rows.label: Robert Hooke
rows.description: English natural philosopher, architect and polymath (1635 — 1703)
rows.hook: looked at cork through a microscope and coined the word cell

rows.label: Carl Benz
rows.description: German automotive and engine designer and manufacturer (1844–1929)
rows.hook: built the first practical gasoline-powered automobile

rows.label: Buckminster Fuller
rows.description: American architect, systems theorist, author, designer, inventor and futurist (1895–1983)
rows.hook: designed the geodesic dome and popularized the phrase Spaceship Earth

rows.label: James Naismith
rows.hook: invented basketball using peach baskets and a soccer ball

rows.label: James Watt
rows.hook: greatly improved the steam engine, helping to power the Industrial Revolution

rows.label: William Shockley
rows.hook: shared a Nobel Prize for the transistor and helped found Silicon Valley's chip industry

rows.label: Alessandro Volta
rows.hook: invented the first electric battery, the voltaic pile

rows.label: Igor Sikorsky
rows.description: American aviation pioneer from Russian Empire (1889–1972)
rows.hook: built the first mass-produced helicopter

rows.label: Samuel Finley Breese Morse
rows.hook: developed the telegraph and a code of dots and dashes

rows.label: Louis Braille
rows.description: French organist and teacher (1809-1852), inventor of braille, a system for reading and writing text and music, used by people who are blind or visually impaired
rows.hook: created a raised-dot reading and writing system for blind people

rows.label: Christiaan Huygens
rows.hook: invented the pendulum clock and discovered Saturn's largest moon

rows.label: Robert H. Goddard
rows.hook: launched the world's first liquid-fueled rocket

rows.label: John Logie Baird
rows.description: Scottish inventor, demonstrating the world's first working television (1888–1946)
rows.hook: gave the first public demonstration of a working television
